title: Eco-friendly ascorbic acid-integrated graphene oxide composite membranes for high performance ionic and molecular sieving in wastewater treatment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,896-907
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW01041A, Paper
Muhammad Naseem Hakro, Jameel Ahmed Baig, Faheeda Soomro, Fozia K. Soomro, Awais Khalid, Ayaz Ali Memon, Ali Hyder, Khalid Hussain Thebo, Ahmed Nadeem
The AA/GO lamellar membrane prepared by a simple method shows excellent water permeability, improved separation of dyes, salts, and heavy metals, and greater structural stability compared to a pristine GO membrane.
